title: GOV-0058: WP-SEC-A — freeze badf-security-design (G05 security-design composition/router; DESIGNED; OWASP adapt-not-authority; design != assurance)
problem:
## Observed

BADF has badf-architecture (G04) and badf-solution-design (G03/G04) ACTIVE, and the lifecycle defines G05 (Security, privacy and AI safety: threat-model / privacy-assessment / supply-chain-plan / security-approval; owner security_authority; min C2) — but no security-design capability exists to author that evidence.

## Expected

**WP-SEC-A — freeze badf-security-design as a G05 security-DESIGN composition/router, DESIGNED only.** Pre-implementation: models how the intended system (architecture + solution baselines) can be abused, derives controls + security requirements, normalizes specialist outputs into the EXISTING G05 design artifacts. Thin router; NOT a scanner, second gate, or authority. Security ASSURANCE (code review, SAST, SCA, secrets, IaC, API/web/mobile review, remediation) is OUT of scope -> future badf-security-assurance at G08/G09. OWASP = ADAPT-as-methodology, never adopt-as-authority. security-approval stays with security_authority. No scripts/badf_security_design.py, no schema, no lifecycle change, no gate-code change.

## Evidence

- lifecycle.json G05 required_evidence confirms the seam (threat-model/privacy-assessment/supply-chain-plan/security-approval).
- Mirrors the badf-solution-design / badf-architecture DESIGNED-first admission ladder (contract freeze, prove later).

## Unknowns

Which specialists earn independent subskill status vs. stay cross-cutting (security-requirements likely cross-cutting) — deferred to WP-SEC-B+.
